name: alces-mcp

tools.name: get_api_references
tools.description: Get references to Jira API documentation and implemented endpoints.

category.description: The API category to get references for. Omit for a category overview.

tag.description: Filter to operations whose catalog tag contains this substring (e.g. "Assets - Object").

search.description: Filter to operations whose path, summary, or operationId contains this substring.

tools.name: list_tool_domains
tools.description: List the 9 tool domains this server groups its 550+ tools into, each domain's tool count, and whether it's currently active (i.e. included in tools/list). Call this first if a tool you expect isn't showing up — activate its domain with activate_tool_domain.

tools.name: activate_tool_domain
tools.description: Make one or more tool domains' tools visible in tools/list for the rest of this session (see list_tool_domains for the domain names). Tools are always callable by name regardless of activation state — this only controls what's advertised, to keep the tool list small.

tools.name: deactivate_tool_domain
tools.description: Remove one or more tool domains from tools/list. The reverse of activate_tool_domain.

instructions: Category-specific operational guidance is available as MCP Resources — several tool descriptions reference the relevant one (e.g. skill://core-issues, skill://admin); call resources/list to see all of them, then resources/read before constructing complex JQL/AQL or working through a multi-step workflow.
